sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Artistic Branch

system.description:
You mold clay, earth, or another inorganic earthen substance into a cluster of small spiders that scurry and skitter at your command, into a space of your choice within range. The Clay Spider has the listed statistics found on its stat block at the end of this clan and uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus or Save DC when an effect calls for it. You can command them as an Action or Bonus action.

You can have up to five Clay Spiders active at once. Summoning a sixth or more Clay Spiders dispels the oldest ones until you have no more than five.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the number of Spiders you Summon by +1.
